content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: HRA as per GoI rules applicable to CSIR employees. Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, not exceeding 06 years.

content_sections.heading: How Will CSIR CSMCRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on criteria fixed by the Selection Committee Interview Shortlisted candidates will be notified through the Institute website and called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of age/date of birth Consolidated mark sheets/certificates of 10th, 12th Undergraduate Degree all semester mark sheets and degree certificate Percentage conversion formula National-level examination certificates/scorecards Experience certificates Publications, conferences, workshops, seminars, awards, achievements, special skills

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the institute website. Fill up the application form carefully and correctly. Send the complete application form via email to [email protected] on or before 09 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No hard copy is required to be sent to the Institute. Applications without signature will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project Associate-I, 1 Project Assistant-II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 9 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Women As per Government of India/CSIR instructions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 31,000+ HRA or 25,000+ HRA for Project Associate-I, Rs. 20,000 + HRA for Project Assistant-II.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E in Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Technology / 3 Years Diploma in Engineering/Technology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Engagement shall not exceed 06 years in any case.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Final Semester/Year students awaiting results are not eligible.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be notified through the Institute website and called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, not exceeding 06 years.
